courses.name: Chestnut Mountain Disc Golf
courses.about: Disc golf (alpha) on the ski hill at Chestnut Mountain Resort (Galena, Illinois; 9 holes, 2010): the nine played twice, from the long tees and then the short ones. Throw with the tempo bar as for a golf swing; the strike dot sets the release angle (hyzer or anhyzer) and the nose. Rounds here are not posted to the world leaderboard. Hole lengths from UDisc; the ground from the USGS 3DEP 1 m elevation model, trees from USGS 3DEP lidar, buildings, ponds and roads from © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
